name: com.qmai.crashlib.CrashDetailsActivity
description: Qmai CrashLib opens this screen after a captured crash in its default immediate-report mode, or when a user selects a saved crash report; it displays the error details and offers copy, share, and screenshot actions.
disableEffect: With CrashLib’s default immediate-report setting, disabling this Activity makes the post-crash report launch fail; saved report details also cannot be opened.
